shots.name: drift-lines-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Drift Lines card: Style menu, Preset menu showing Rain Curtain, then Band Size, Angle, Drift and Speed, beside a strip of the preview with thin vertical bands
shots.caption: Drift Lines with the Rain Curtain preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Band Size. 3 — Angle: 90° stands the bands upright. 4 — Drift.

shots.name: crosshatch-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Crosshatch card: Style menu, Preset menu showing Etching, then Line Spacing, Line Weight, Amount, Ink and Paper, beside a strip of the preview drawn in fine brown lines on cream
shots.caption: Crosshatch with the Etching preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Line Spacing. 3 — Line Weight: how heavy the lines get in the shadows. 4 — Amount. 5 — Ink.

shots.name: vector-tiling-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Vector Engraving card: Style menu, Preset menu showing Copper Plate, then Line Spacing, Angle, Line Weight, Amount, Ink and Paper, beside a strip of the preview drawn in wavy brown lines on cream
shots.caption: Vector Engraving with the Copper Plate preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Line Spacing. 3 — Angle: the direction of the lines. 4 — Line Weight: how heavy the lines get in the shadows. 5 — Ink.
